correctness.rationale: A real Haar n-by-2 frame has two-row density proportional to det(I-R^T R)^((n-5)/2). Polar row coordinates give the exact density on the positive determinant support. The angular kernel gives strict likelihood-ratio ordering in n. The n=4 elliptic reduction and an auxiliary-variable monotone likelihood-ratio coupling prove the existence and uniqueness of the q threshold. The numerical checker independently tests matrix identities, conditional cosines and the elliptic root.

value.rationale: The alignment of two randomly chosen closed-polygon edges at fixed side lengths is a directly motivated joint geometric statistic. The complete sign and stochastic-order phase diagram, with the universal elliptic boundary unique to quadrilaterals and exact pentagon independence of angle on the short-length region, is a meaningful natural classification rather than a parameter-specific recomputation.
